judgment_unit: One query against one filter-eligible chunk, using its exact text plus supplied document title/source metadata; no unseen neighboring text or omitted images.
positive: The chunk supplies direct substantive evidence for at least one specifically requested fact or part of the information need, even if several passages are needed for a full answer. Mere keyword/topic overlap is insufficient.
negative: The inspected chunk does not supply substantive evidence for any specifically requested fact. Related subject matter, identifier mentions or a shared API family alone are not relevant.
uncertain: Ambiguous support or scope must be marked unresolved during annotation and adjudicated before qrels freeze; it must not silently become negative.
filters: Metadata-filter tasks admit only their specified doc.kind. Ineligible pairs are outside the judgment universe, not labeled negative.
independence: Prepare judgments from source evidence before any new product/baseline rankings, tuning or quality metrics. Task-author anchors are provisional; unlisted chunks are not assumed negative.
quality_thresholds: No numeric relevance gate or superiority requirement is introduced.
